cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Olefin sulfonate, isethionate and sulfosuccinate prevent a low cleansing call.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate conditioning remains final because avocado/macadamia oils, panthenol and two cationic polymers support care, while the product is not a rich 2-in-1 and has no silicone.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: The volume positioning and broad cleanser system argue against high conditioning.

weightPotential.rationale: Moderate weight potential remains final because two oils and two cationic polymers create bounded residue risk, despite volume positioning and no silicone.
weightPotential.counterSignal: The exact positioning seeks fullness/body and the formula is silicone-free, with meaningful surfactant reset capacity.

unresolvedFacts: A distinct global manufacturer market/formula variant is preserved and not merged into the exact-GTIN formula.
Acrylates Copolymer, Cyclodextrin and Hydroxypropyl Starch Phosphate remain helper/texture facts, not counted as substantive conditioning routes.
weightAssessment.whyThisBand: Oil and cationic polymer deposition can plausibly reduce movement for some hair, but reset and no silicone keep it bounded.
weightAssessment.whyNotNeighborBand: High would overread helper polymers and ignore the broad cleanser system; low would understate the oils plus cationic polymers.

focusPrimary.rationale: Volume is final because the exact German name and global positioning target fullness/body for fine or thin hair, and the formula has compatible cleanser and texture-helper signals; confidence stays moderate because oils/cationic polymers are weight counter-signals and the detailed claim source is not the canonical formula authority.
focusPrimary.counterSignal: Macadamia/avocado oils and two cationic polymers work against maximum lightness, and the global manufacturer formula is preserved only as a variant.

focusSecondary.rationale: No secondary focus is retained because the care/oil story is a weight trade-off inside the volume product, not a distinct second v1.4 role.
focusSecondary.counterSignal: No explicit repair, shine, clarifying or scalp-active secondary is established for the exact German product.

usageRole.rationale: Regular remains final because directions are ordinary apply-to-wet-hair, lather and rinse well, with no treatment or reset cadence.
usageRole.counterSignal: Volume positioning does not create an alternating or reset role.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Not targeted remains final because revealed claims target volume/fullness, not sensitive or uncomfortable scalp.
scalpComfortTarget.counterSignal: Glycerin and panthenol are comfort-adjacent, but no scalp-comfort intent is revealed.
